messages:
Elle (SRE): Posting a condensed follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A about the routing overload incident (INC-2026-051). RCA is live: https://redwood.internal/rcas/INC-2026-051. Pls use this thread for ownership and short updates.
Rohan (eng): Thanks. TL;DR for folks who missed it: a control-plane spike caused many short-lived model loads, thrashing the KV cache and driving router latency up for ~90m.
Maya (product): Can we get a 2-line customer-ready summary? We need it for outreach.
Elle (SRE): Customer summary: "We experienced elevated latency when an internal control-plane job caused excessive model load requests; services returned to normal after throttling was applied. We're adding safeguards to prevent similar load storms."
Jamie (CEO): Two leadership asks: 1) named owners + dates; 2) a single-line prevention policy we can publish internally.
Elle (SRE): Owners + ETAs below. I'll update the all-hands tracker doc after this thread.
Elle (SRE): Action A: Add deploy-time throttle protection for control-plane jobs (reject/queue excessive model-loads) 1 owner: Rohan (eng) 1 ETA: 2026-03-31.
Elle (SRE): Action B: Add end-to-end load test (simulate 10x model-loads) and CI gate 1 owner: Rohan (eng) 1 ETA: 2026-04-07.
Elle (SRE): Action C: Add KV cache saturation alert + dashboard tile for tail latency per-pool 1 owner: Elle (SRE) 1 ETA: 2026-03-28.
Elle (SRE): Action D: Draft customer outreach + impacted-account list 1 owner: Maya (product) 1 ETA: 2026-03-27.
Rohan (eng): Patch note: adding a throttler at control-plane enqueue point. Snippet for config threshold: max_concurrent_model_loads: 12. I'll open PR and link here.
Maya (product): opsbot, can you pull impacted accounts for the affected pools? We need priority list.
opsbot: Impact extract complete: 7 accounts flagged as affected. Link: https://ops.redwood/impacts/INC-2026-051
Jamie (CEO): Good. Make sure comms are coordinated with account owners and AE team.
Rohan (eng): Opening PR now: https://git.redwood/eng/PR-4310 1 includes unit test and a short e2e harness. Will link CI run once complete.
Elle (SRE): I'll add the KV cache saturation alert rule and post the dashboard screenshot here when done.
Maya (product): Draft customer note ready for review, posting to #customer-comms in 10m.
comms-bot: Draft posted: https://redwood.internal/comms/drafts/INC-2026-051-draft. Please review by EOD.
Rohan (eng): Quick Q: do we also want a blacklist for aggressive control-plane callers, or just throttling?
Jamie (CEO): Throttle first; blacklist only if we see repeat offenders. Document decision and owner.
Elle (SRE): Noted. Action E: decision doc for rate-limiting policy (throttle vs blacklist) 1 owner: Elle (SRE) 1 ETA: 2026-04-02.
Maya (product): Closing ask: once PRs merge, update the all-hands follow-up tracker link so leadership can validate.
Elle (SRE): Will do. Marking this thread as canonical for small updates. If owners change ETAs, edit the tracker. :white_check_mark:
